cohort_total_n_excerpt: We examined the incidence of prostate cancer in relation to prediagnostic serum calcium levels in a prospective cohort study of 22,391 healthy Swedish men, of which 1,539 incident cases of prostate cancer were diagnosed during the 30 years of follow-up until December 2006.
reason: The abstract analyzes incident prostate cancer overall and does not report an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: We found no evidence of an association between prediagnostic serum levels of calcium and risk of prostate cancer (HR for trend = 0.99 [95% CI;0.94-1.03]).
estimate_classifications.reason: The HR for trend concerns overall incident prostate cancer.
